n-k-k3-01.title: Impelaveki ekhaya?
n-k-k3-01.goal: Thelekisa ibango eliqinileyo lomfundi osebenza naye nedayari emfutshane, khetha igama lokuphindaphinda ubungqina elixhasayo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni 'ngalo lonke ixesha' kuninzi kakhulu.
n-k-k3-01.material:
Umfundi osebenza naye uthi: "세진은 주말에 항상 집에 있어요." Ufunda idayari yeempelaveki ye-세진 yeeveki ezine:

1주 토요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
1주 일요일: 집에서 책을 읽었어요.
2주 토요일: 친구랑 극장에서 영화를 봤어요.
2주 일요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
3주 토요일: 집에서 게임을 했어요.
3주 일요일: 집에서 청소를 했어요.
4주 토요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
4주 일요일: 공원에서 자전거를 탔어요.
n-k-k3-01.thinking.2: Umzekelo o-1 ochasayo uphula 'ngalo lonke ixesha'
n-k-k3-01.prereq.1: Uyazi 항상 (ngalo lonke ixesha) kunye ne-아니에요 (ayiyo); amanye amagama okuphindaphinda (보통, 가끔, 거의) achazwa kwizalathiso nakwinkcazo
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.prompt: Sesiphi isivakalisi malunga no-세진 esixhaswe kakhulu yidayari yonke?
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bala bangaphi kwiintsuku zempelaveki ezi-8 ezachithwa ekhaya nezo zingachithwanga.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hambelanisa amanani akho amabini namagama: 항상 = ixesha ngalinye, 보통 = ixesha elininzi, 가끔 = ngamanye amaxesha, 거의 없어요 = phantse akukho.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.a: Iintsuku ezi-2 kwezisibhozo zachithwa ngaphandle (isinema nepaki), ngoko 'ngalo lonke ixesha' lihamba ngaphezu kwedayari.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.b: Iintsuku ezi-6 kwezisibhozo zaziyekhaya, ngoko 'akukho ekhaya' kuchasene noko idayari ikubonisayo.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.d: I-'가끔' ithetha ngamanye amaxesha kuphela. Idayari ibonisa ekhaya ngeentsuku ezininzi, nto leyo engaphezu kwe-'ngamanye amaxesha'.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.e: I-'거의 없어요' ithetha phantse akukho ekhaya, nto leyo echasene neentsuku ezi-6 kwezisibhozo ekhaya.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.explain: Bala iintsuku: iintsuku ezi-6 kwezi-8 zempelaveki zazisekhaya, ezi-2 zazingekhoyo. Igama le-'ixesha elininzi' (보통) liyahambelana; igama le-'ixesha ngalinye' (항상) liqinile kakhulu, kwaye i-'ngamanye amaxesha' okanye i-'phantse akukho' ibuthathaka kakhulu.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi osebenza naye uthi '세진은 주말에 항상 집에 있어요.' Zeziphi iingeniso zedayari ezibonisa ukuba eli bango alilonyani? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ibango limalunga NEENTSUKU ZONKE zempelaveki. Luhlobo luni losuku olunokulaphula: olo luhambelana nebango okanye olo lungahambelani?
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kwingeniso ngayinye, gqiba: ihambelana nebango okanye iyalaphula?
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.a: Olu suku lwaluse khaya, ngoko luvumelana nebango. Alunakubonisa ukuba ibango liphosakele.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.c: Olu suku lwaluse khaya nalo, ngoko luvumelana nebango.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.explain: Ibango elinge-'ngalo lonke ixesha' liphulwa sisuku olunye olungahambelaniyo. Iintsuku ezichithwe ekhaya zivumelana nebango kuphela; azinakulibonisa, kuba ibango limalunga neentsuku zonke.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.acc.0: Umzekelo o-1 ochasayo wanele ukuphula i-'항상'; owesi-2, i-4주 일요일, ubonisa ukuba ayizange ibe yinto yexesha elilodwa.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.prompt: Phendula umfundi osebenza naye ngesiKorea (intetho eneenkcubeko -요). Thi i-'항상' ayichanekanga, unike usuku olu-1 olusuka kwidayari njengobungqina.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngecandelo elithi 'hayi ngalo lonke ixesha', emva koko wongeze ingeniso e-1 esuka kwidayari.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.1: Yitsho ukuba 세진 wayekuphi ngolo suku, usebenzisa i--에서.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ndikhankanye usuku okanye indawo e-1 ethile esuka kwidayari?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ndithe 'hayi ngalo lonke ixesha' endaweni ye-'akunjalo'?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba impendulo yam inobuhlobo kwaye ayinabukrwada?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ikhankanya igama elingcono kwaye inika ubungqina.

n-k-k3-02.title: Icebo luka-하나 nesaziso sethala leencwadi
n-k-k3-02.topic: Ukungqubana kwexesha nendawo phakathi kwecebo nesaziso
n-k-k3-02.goal: Hlola icebo leveki lomhlobo ngokuchasene nesaziso, ufumane umgca o-1 ongqubanayo, uthi luhlobo luni lokungqubana, uze ulungise icebo.
n-k-k3-02.material:
하나 ukuthumelela icebo lakhe leli veki. Ithala leencwadi lesikolo lipapashe esi saziso:

[학교 도서관 안내]
- 문을 열어요: 화요일~일요일, 오전 9시~오후 6시
- 월요일은 쉬어요.
- 책은 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
n-k-k3-02.prereq.1: Uyazi iintsuku zeveki ne-오전/오후 + inani + 시
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.prompt: Icebo luka-하나 leli veki alihambelani nesaziso sethala leencwadi kumgca o-1. Khetha lo mgca.
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala dwelisa iintsuku neeyure apho ithala leencwadi livulekile, usebenzisa isaziso kuphela.
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola yonke umgca okhankanya ithala leencwadi: ingaba usuku NEYURE ziyahambelana noluhlu lwakho?
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.explain: Umgca 2 uthi ithala leencwadi ngoMvulo, kodwa isaziso sithi ithala leencwadi livaliwe ngoMvulo. Umgca 5 (ngeCawa, 5 p.m.) ulungile kuba ithala leencwadi livulekile ngeCawa ukuya kuma-6 p.m.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.0: Thelekisa usuku kumgca nesaziso, emva koko uthelekise iyure.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.1: Yitsho ukuba leliphi kwabo bobabini (usuku, iyure), ukuba likhona, elingahambelani nesaziso.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.a: 하나 uceba ukuya phambi kokuba ithala leencwadi livule.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.a: Iyure yokuvula yi-9 a.m., ngoko i-10 a.m. ingaphakathi kweeyure zokuvula; ingxaki yenye inkcukacha.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.b: 하나 uceba ukuya ngosuku apho icebo lakhe lingqubana nolunye umgca.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.b: Akukho omnye umgca wecebo lakhe oweza kuloo suku, ngoko asiyiyo ingxaki.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.c: 하나 uceba ukuya ngexesha emva kokuba ithala leencwadi livaliwe.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.c: Iyure (10 a.m.) ingaphakathi kweeyure zokuvula; ingxaki yenye inkcukacha.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.d: 하나 uceba ukuya ngosuku apho ithala leencwadi livaliwe.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.explain: Iyure ilungile, kodwa usuku oluvaliweyo lwenza utyelelo lonke lungabi nakwenzeka. Ukuhlola icebo ngokuchasene nesaziso kuthetha ukuhlola yonke inkcukacha (usuku, iyure, indawo), kwaye inkcukacha e-1 yanele ukulaphula.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kwakhona umgca ophosakeleyo ngesiKorea (intetho eneenkcubeko) ukuze icebo lisebenze. Gcina injongo (ukuboleka iincwadi), kodwa utshintshe usuku okanye ixesha.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha usuku ezivulekileyo zesaziso; emva koko ukhethe iyure phakathi kokuvula nokuvala.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.1: Gcina iphatheni usuku + ixesha: indawo + into + isenzi, njengakwezinye imigca.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba usuku olutsha lolo apho ithala leencwadi livulekile?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ixesha lam elitsha lihambelana neeyure zokuvula (9 a.m. ukuya kwi-6 p.m.)?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba usuku olutsha lungqubana nolunye umgca kwicebo luka-하나?

n-k-k3-03.title: Umhla wemuvi onemida
n-k-k3-03.goal: Guqula umbhalo womhlobo onemida emininzi (iintsuku ezingekho, iyure yokuqala, ixesha lokuphela elimisiweyo) ube ngamacebo asemthethweni, ufumane ngaphezu kwelinye, uze uxele elinye ngesiKorea.
n-k-k3-03.material:
지호 uthumela umbhalo:

"이번 주 평일에 같이 영화를 봐요! 월요일이랑 수요일에는 학원이 있어서 안 돼요. 다른 날은 오후 3시 이후에 시간이 있어요. 영화는 두 시간이에요. 오후 6시까지는 끝나야 해요."
n-k-k3-03.thinking.0: Imeko efihliweyo: ubude bemuvi butshintsha ixesha lokuqala
n-k-k3-03.prereq.1: Uyazi iintsuku zeveki kunye ne-오후 + inani + 시
n-k-k3-03.prereq.2: Uhlangabezane ne--까지 (de, ngeli xesha), 이후 (emva) kunye ne-전에 (phambi); zichazwe kwizalathiso
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.prompt: Imuvi iyiyure ezi-2 kwaye kufuneka iphele ngama-6 p.m. Lilixesha lini LAMVA NJE lokuqala elisebenzayo?
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha i-6 o'clock uthabathe ubude bemuvi.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola impendulo yakho ngokongeza iiyure ezi-2 kuyo. Ingaba isiphumo si-6 okanye sangaphambili?
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.b: Lelixesha imuvi kufuneka igqitywe ngalo, hayi ixesha enokuqala ngalo.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.c: Ukuqala ngama-5 p.m. kuthetha ukuba imuvi iphela ngama-7 p.m., emva kwe-6.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.d: Ama-3 p.m. asebenza, kodwa lixesha lokuqala lamva lomhlobo wakho elivumelekileyo, hayi lamva nje.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.explain: Ukuqala + iiyure ezi-2 kufuneka kube ngama-6 okanye ngaphambili, ngoko ukuqala kuma-4 ngamva nje. Kunye ne-'emva kwama-3 p.m.' kuphela ama-3 nama-4 anokwenzeka.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.prompt: Fumana amacebo ama-3 ahambelana nazo zonke iimeko kumyalezo ka-지호, nganye ngosuku olwahlukileyo okanye ngexesha elahlukileyo. d = inani losuku (월=1, 화=2, 수=3, 목=4, 금=5); h = iyure imuvi eqala ngayo, emva kwemini (3 ithetha ama-3 p.m.).
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.0: 이후 = emva (kubalwa ukusuka) ngelo xesha; -까지 = ukuya kuthi ga / ngelo xesha.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala umyalezo ngamazwi akho njengemithetho eyahlukileyo: ziintsuku ezintoni ezingekho, ukususela kweyiphi iyure, nokuba imuvi iphela ngeyiphi iyure.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.2: Yenza iintsuku kuqala: ngqumla i-월 ne-수. Emva koko zama iyure ngayinye yokuqala wongeze ezi-2.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.3: Ukuba elinye lamacebo akho liyanqatshwa, funda umyalezo ngezantsi kwetheyibhile: uthi leyiphi umthetho ewohlulekileyo.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.var.h: iyure yokuqala emva kwemini (3 = ama-3 p.m.)
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c0: Sebenzisa inani eliphelele leentsuku nekhefu eliphelele.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 지호 ufuna usuku lweveki, ngoko d ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-5.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c3: 지호 ukhululekile kuphela ukusuka ngentsimbi yesi-3 emva kwemini.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Imuvi iphela ngentsimbi yesi-6 emva kwemini.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Imuvi yeeyure ezi-2 eqala emva kwexesha elinje iphela emva kwentsimbi yesi-6 emva kwemini.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.explain: Iintsuku zinokuba yi-화, 목 okanye 금, yaye ixesha lokuqala linokuba yintsimbi yesi-3 okanye yesi-4 emva kwemini, ngoko kukho izicwangciso ezi-6. Umyalezo unika imida, hayi idinga elinye elichanekileyo.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha OMNYE kwizicwangciso zakho uthumele 지호 umyalezo omfutshane ngesiKorean (ngesimilo esihloniphekileyo -요) onosuku, ixesha lokuqala nemuvi.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sebenzisa isicwangciso esinye ekuphuma ngasentla: luluphi usuku nikwi yure?
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Chaza usuku, emva koko ixesha, emva koko imuvi, uze ugqibele nge-요.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba usuku neyure yam ziyahambelana nesicwangciso esinye endasakhayo?
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba imithetho ka-지호 ibiya kuhlonitshwa ukuba uthi ewe?

n-k-k3-04.s.s1.hint.0: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-k-k3-04.title: Ngaba 민수 uyeza kwipikiniki?
n-k-k3-04.goal: Hlaziya ingcamango malunga nokuba umntu osebenza naye eklasini uyeza na njengoko imiyalezo emitsha ifika, khangela amagama okuqikelela, uze wazise iindaba ngobungakanani obufanelekileyo bokuqiniseka.
n-k-k3-04.material: Uqokelela amagama epikiniki yeklasi ngoMgqibelo uze ufune ukwazi ukuba umdla kangakanani kufuneka uthenge. Uzibuza ukuba 민수 uyeza na. Imiyalezo ifika enye ngexesha.
n-k-k3-04.thinking.1: Ngubani oyithethileyo (ukuqikelela komhlobo xa kuthelekiswa nelo lomntu ngokwakhe)
n-k-k3-04.thinking.2: Ukutshintsha isigqibo xa kufika ulwazi olutsha
n-k-k3-04.prereq.1: Uyayazi 아마 (mhlawumbi) kunye -ㄹ 것 같아요 (kubonakala ngathi); zichazwe kumacebiso
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda umyalezo ngamnye ngokulandelelana, khetha indlela yokuwuqonda ebonakala inokwenzeka kakhulu, uze uqhubeke.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qaphela ukuba ubani othethayo kumyalezo ngamnye, nokuba ngawaphi amagama athambisa isivakalisi (아마, -ㄹ 것 같아요).
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uqinisekile kangakanani 지아 ukuba 민수 uza kuza ngoMgqibelo?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.after: 아마 ibonisa ukuqikelela. Kweli nqanaba, 'mhlawumbi uyeza' yindlela efanelekileyo yokuqonda, hayi 'ngokuqinisekileyo uyeza'.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Akukho nto kwisivakalisi ethi akazukuza; '올 거예요' ikhomba ekuzeni.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ucinga ukuba mhlawumbi uza kuza, kodwa akaqinisekanga.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uthetha ngaye njengomntu amaziyo; isivakalisi sibhekisele ekubeni uza okanye hayi.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngoku 민수 uthetha ngokwakhe. Umfanekiso ubonakala unjani?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.after: -ㄹ 것 같아요 kunye 아직 몰라요 zibonisa umbuzo ovulekileyo. Oko umntu athi ngokwakhe kubalulekile ngaphezu kokuqikelela komhlobo.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Akukagqitywa: usenokuba notyelelo esibhedlele, ngoko usenokungakwazi ukuza.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mhlawumbi uza kuza, kuba 지아 ekutshilo.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ngoku umntu ngokwakhe uthi akaqinisekanga, ngoko ukuqikelela kuka-지아 kunobunzima obuncinci.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: '갈 것 같아요' ibhekisele kutyelelo olunokwenzeka ngexesha elizayo, hayi into esele yenzekile.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: '아직 몰라요' ithetha ukuba akazigqibanga, ngoko awunakuthi akazukuza.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Umyalezo omtsha ufaka indawo yokuqikelela kwakudala: ukuza ngoku sele kucacile kakhulu, ngelixa 'ukulibala kancinci' kusekukuqikelela (-ㄹ 것 같아요).
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Utyelelo lwesibhedlele sele lugqityiwe (다녀왔어요), yaye uthi unokuza.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uthi uza kulibala kancinci, ngoko akufuneki ucebe ngokufika ngexesha.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ngoku uthi ngokucacileyo ukuba unokuya ngoMgqibelo; umbuzo ovulekileyo wangoyena sele uphendulwe.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 민수 unokuza ngoMgqibelo, mhlawumbi elibele kancinci.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.reflect: Ingcamango yakho ngoba 민수 itshintshe ngomyalezo ngamnye. Ukuqikelela komhlobo (아마) kwafakelwa indawo ngamagama akhe angaqinisekanga, emva koko ngamagama akhe acacileyo. Amagama anje nge-아마 kunye -ㄹ 것 같아요 abonisa ukuqikelela, yaye umyalezo omtsha kakhulu ovela kumntu ngokwakhe ngowona mthombo ungcono.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.prompt: Zeziphi kwezi zibaso zimiyalezo emithathu ezibonisa ukuba ithethi akaqinisekanga ngokupheleleyo? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.0: Buza ngesibaso ngasinye: ingaba ithethi ixela into eyenzekileyo, okanye iqikelela ngento enokwenzeka?
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukufaka isibaso ngo 'ngokuqinisekileyo'. Ngaba isivakalisi siyaqhubeka sinengqiniseko?
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.r.b: Esi sisivakalisi esicacileyo sento esele yenzekile, ngoko siyinyani, asiyonto yokuqikelela.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.explain: 아마 ithetha mhlawumbi, -ㄹ 것 같아요 ithetha 'kubonakala ukuba', kwaye 아직 몰라요 ithetha 'andikayazi okwangoku'. Isivakalisi sexesha elidlulileyo njenge-다녀왔어요 sixela inyani.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.prompt: Bhalela iqela lencoko yepikiniki iindaba ngesiKorean (intetho ehloniphekileyo): yithi 민수 uyeza, uphawule into enye eseyiyo kuphela ukuqikelela.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala izivakalisi ezimbini ezimfutshane: esinye sento ecacileyo, esinye sento engacacanga.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kwinxalenye engacacanga, sebenzisa igama okanye isiphelo osidibene naso kwimiyalezo.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndiyigcinile inxalenye 'yokulibala kancinci' njengokuqikelela hayi njengenyani?
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba iqela liya kwazi ukuba kufuneka libale abantu aba bangakanani?

n-k-k3-05.title: Ngubani 하준 athetha ngaye ngo '저도요'?
n-k-k3-05.topic: Ngubani othethe ntoni: impendulo exhomekeke kumgca wangaphambili
n-k-k3-05.goal: Ukuqonda ukuba ngubani nantoni ebhekiselwe kuyo ngu 'nam' omfutshane kwincoko yeqela, ukugqiba ukuba ngawaphi amaqunga olwazi asaphosakeleyo kwisigqibo seqela, nokubuza enye yawo.
n-k-k3-05.material:
Abahlobo abathathu bakhetha isidlo sasemini kwincoko yeqela. I-비빔밥 yeresityu ihlala iza nesosi ebukhali ebomvu yepelepele (고추장).

지아: 저는 비빔밥을 먹을래요.
하준: 저도 비빔밥이 좋아요.
서윤: 저는 매운 음식을 못 먹어요.
하준: 저도요.
n-k-k3-05.thinking.0: Ngubani othethe ntoni, nokuba impendulo ibhekisele kuntoni
n-k-k3-05.prereq.2: Uyayazi 맵다 (ibukhali) kwifom 매운 / 안 매워요
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.prompt: Funda incoko. Kumgca wokugqibela, 하준 uthetha ntoni ngo '저도요'?
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana umgca ngqo ngaphezu kwe '저도요'. Yiloo nto avumelana nayo.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.a: Naye ufuna ukutya i-비빔밥, njengoko 지아.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.a: '저도요' iphendula umgca ongaphambi kwayo. Lo mgca ngowe-서윤, hayi owe-지아.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.b: Naye ufuna ukutya isidlo sasemini kunye ne-서윤.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.b: Umgca ongaphambili ngokutya, hayi ngokutya kunye.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.c: Naye ucinga ukuba i-비빔밥 ibukhali kakhulu.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.c: 서윤 uthi kuphela akakwazi ukutya ukutya okubukhali. 하준 uphendula lo mgca kwaye akathethi nto nge-비빔밥 apha.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.d: Naye akakwazi ukutya ukutya okubukhali, njengo-서윤.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.explain: '-도' (nako) idibanisa oko kuthethwa ngoku nento ebisandul' ukuthethwa. Umgca ongaphambi kowe-하준 ngowe-서윤: akakwazi ukutya ukutya okubukhali. Ngoko 하준 naye akakwazi. Imigca emibini ngaphambili wathi uyayithanda i-비빔밥, ngoko kufuneka ecinga ukuba i-비빔밥 ingathamba.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngaba bonke abahlobo abathathu bangayitya i-비빔밥 kunye? Khetha ZONKE izinto osafuna ukuzifumanisa phambi kokuba uphendule.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza uluhlu lwento ethethwe ngumntu ngamnye, uphawule into ekusasilele kumntu ngamnye.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.hint.1: Cima iinyani ezingayi kutshintsha impendulo, nokuba zitshintsha njani.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.b: Ukuba 하준 ngenene akakwazi ukutya ukutya okubukhali
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.b: Sele ethethe ngo-저도요, ngoko sele uyazi.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.c: Oko 지아 akutyileyo izolo akunqumi oko abathathu banokukutya namhlanje.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.d: Ukuba 서윤 ukulungele ukuba nge-비빔밥 ukuba ayibukhali
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.e: 지아 ufuna i-비빔밥 nangayiphi na indlela; incasa yakhe yokubukhali ayibavimbeli abanye ukuba bayitye.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.explain: Zimbini izinto ezivulekileyo. Ukutya kufuneka kwenzeke kungabukhali, yaye 서윤 uthethe kuphela oko angakwaziyo ukukutya, hayi oko akufunayo. Ezinye iinyani aziyitshintshi impendulo.
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umbuzo kwincoko yeqela ngesiKorean (intetho ehloniphekileyo) ofumana ngawo enye yeenyani ezingekhoyo. Ungagqibi ngabo nje.
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba impendulo ingandinika enye yeenyani ezimbini ezingekhoyo?
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba umbuzo wam uhloniphekile kwaye kulula ukuphendulwa ngesivakalisi esinye esifutshane?
